title: Convert ReminderPreferences to @freezed instead of hand-rolled ==/hashCode/copyWith
why: Matches the coding standard's explicit rule to never hand-write ==/hashCode for data classes. The 7 fields are consistent between == and hashCode today, but every future field addition is a manual 3-way sync across the constructor, ==, hashCode and copyWith -- an easy place to introduce a silent equality bug (a field present in the constructor but missed in == makes two logically-different instances compare equal).
acceptance_criteria: dart run build_runner build generates the freezed file and existing tests (e.g. notification_providers_deep_test.dart groups H/A-E) keep passing unmodified.
